name: Alli Willow

credits.title: Yellow Cake
credits.overview: When radical science backfires, miners and researchers confront apocalypse in Tiago Melo’s pulpy, politically charged sci-fi fusing local myth, dark humour, working-class grit and radioactivity in Brazil’s Northeast.

credits.title: Criadas
credits.overview: Sandra returns to her cousin Mariana’s house in search of a photo of her late mother, who worked as a live-in maid for Mariana’s parents. credits.title: Warden
credits.overview: A docu-style science fiction thriller exploring the real-world impact of a young man discovering his superpowers. It delves into how his presence influences society, attracting followers, sparking conflict, and changing the lives of everyone around him.

credits.title: Tinnitus
credits.overview: Marina Lenk is an experienced synchronized diver. However, an attack of Tinnitus — an unbearable ringing sound in the ears — drags her from the top of her game to the edge of madness.

credits.title: Distritc 666
credits.overview: In a dystopian world, young people discover government secrets about the pandemic. While fighting oppression, they try to survive.

credits.title: Voragem
credits.overview: When obsessively preparing for her next role, the actress is sucked into a maelstrom caused by her own paranoia.

credits.title: Protesys

credits.title: Three Summers
credits.overview: Over a trio of summers, a caretaker for luxury condominiums relies on her resourcefulness and her eye for opportunity to take advantage of whatever comes her way.

credits.title: Bacurau
credits.overview: Bacurau, a small town in the Brazilian sertão, mourns the loss of its matriarch, Carmelita, who lived to be 94. Days later, its inhabitants notice that their community has vanished from most maps.

credits.title: Intime Conviction
credits.overview: Philippe Villers, coroner, found his wife shot once in the head on his way home one evening. After investigation, Detective Judith Lebrun, define Villers as responsible for the murder.
